Bible study groups
for every season.

From Sunday school to fellowship as adults, there’s a group for every stage of life. Many meet in homes, and some right after the Sunday service.

Kids

Up to grade 4

Children’s Sunday School

While you worship, your kids are learning about Jesus. Bible stories, music, crafts and lessons made for their age, taught by our volunteer Sunday school teachers during the service.

Every Sunday, during the 1:30 PM service

Ask about this group
Youth

Teens

Youth Ministry

Led by Pastor Jaden Esquejo, our youth ministry is built on discipleship, not programs. Teens open the Bible together, ask honest questions, and learn how the gospel is lived out.

Ask about this group

Wherever you are, start here.

Two gatherings open to everyone, whether you’re brand new to faith or have walked with Jesus for decades.

Discovery Bible Study

New to faith, or want a refresher?

Discovery is a Bible study for beginners that meets after the Sunday service.

In a small group, we walk through the foundations of the Christian faith, from the grace of God to the assurance of salvation.

Ask about this group

Wednesday Prayer Meeting

Every Wednesday at 7 PM.

Led by Pastor Wendell Olojan, we pray for one another, our community and those who are sick.

Each meeting also has a devotional to dig deeper into the Word.

Ask about this group

Sunday doesn’t end
at the benediction.

When the service ends, the conversation keeps going.

  1. 1:30 PM

    Worship and the Word

    We sing, pray and open the Bible together. Kids head to Sunday school during the service.

  2. After the service

    Connect Groups

    Discovery and the men’s and women’s Bible studies meet, and some young adults stay for their own study.

  3. Stay a while

    Time to talk

    There’s always time to catch up, and some afternoons end with a game of pickleball.

Serve with us.

Every ministry at Faith Life is carried by people from our church family. Find a place where your gifts help others meet Jesus.

  • Outreach & Evangelism

    Helps our church share the gospel with friends and family.

    Ask about serving

  • Worship

    Leads us in worship each Sunday, together with our AV team running ProPresenter and audio.

    Ask about serving

  • Ushering

    Greets everyone who walks through the door and helps them feel at home.

    Ask about serving

  • Social Concern

    Gives practical help to people facing hard seasons in life.

    Ask about serving

  • Missions Team

    Spearheads our missional work, from supporting missionaries financially to sending out missionaries from our own church.

    Ask about serving

  • Christian Education

    Our Children’s Sunday School teachers and Bible study facilitators, teaching God’s Word at every age.

    Ask about serving
